summary: MT-025 Design Validation + Founder Review Copy download reliability — fully validated. 14/14 backend pytest tests passed and full frontend Founder workflow verified across Book/Presentation/Poster: green Treasure Standard™ Approved badges render, every download link (html/epub/pdf/pptx/png) returns Content-Disposition: attachment with correct Content-Type, hrefs include ?download=1&name=, real Playwright browser download events fire cross-origin, Open Review Copy serves inline HTML with QRU PRESS™ masthead + Treasure Standard™ seal, and the design gate correctly blocks release (400 with 'design review' message) when design_review_required=true while approved products still publish.
critical_code_review_comments: deliverable_renderer.assess_design_quality() correctly implements 9 weighted criteria totaling 100 points and enforces DESIGN_THRESHOLD=85. The 'Cover design' criterion depends on Pillow being able to open cover_bytes; the poster caps at 90 because the deterministic premium_cover output doesn't meet the 1000x1000 minimum — this is graded (not gated) and still passes threshold. Reasonable.

routers/rendering.py:asset() sanitizes filename correctly (allows alnum, space, dot, underscore, dash) and appends the correct extension when the caller-provided name omits it. FileResponse is invoked with both filename= kwarg AND explicit Content-Disposition header — FastAPI reconciles cleanly (header override wins). Working end-to-end.

manufacturing2.release_product() runs unmet-gates check BEFORE design_review_required — correct ordering: pending gates first, then deliverable-ready, then design gate. Message contains 'design review' as required.

customer_deliverable.design_review is snapshotted into published_deliverable at release (verified via published_deliverable in release response). The snapshot preserves grade/approved/status/criteria so audits after publish are trivial.

ProductDetail.js hrefs use `${abs(f.url)}?download=1&name=<encoded title>` — because backend enforces Content-Disposition, the cross-origin `download` HTML attribute ignore-behavior is bypassed (Playwright confirmed real download events fire on the preview subdomain).

Nit: The 'Set Permanent Password' banner appears for the Founder session in every product page. Not a bug — intentional temporary-password reminder — but overlaps zero interactive controls in the Review Copy panel.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 products, all download formats, real browser download events verified)
